## coverage.changed

- **Type:** `boolean | string`
- **Default:** `false` (inherits from `test.changed`)
- **Available for providers:** `'v8' | 'istanbul'`
- **CLI:** `--coverage.changed`, `--coverage.changed=<commit/branch>`

Collect coverage only for files changed since a specified commit or branch. When set to `true`, it uses staged and unstaged changes.

### coverage.changed

- **CLI:** `--coverage.changed <commit/branch>`
- **Config:** [coverage.changed](/config/coverage#coverage-changed)

Collect coverage only for files changed since a specified commit or branch (e.g., `origin/main` or `HEAD~1`). Inherits value from `--changed` by default.

Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
